text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I see. With this, we should be able to 
conduct efficient training without putting 
undue strain on the body.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
My proposal is as I explained earlier, but 
is there anything you found concerning――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...No. I was just thinking back to when we 
first met, and how much our relationship 
has changed since then.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined we would end up 
exchanging opinions like this, to be 
honest.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Looking back, so much has happened, 
hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Your attitude toward Umamusume has 
reminded me of something truly precious.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you are not a flawless person. 
To be frank, there are plenty of things I 
could say to you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, this much comes straight from my 
heart. ...Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I am grateful to you from the bottom of my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
We certainly cannot afford to let our 
guard down just yet, but at any rate, we 
have reached a milestone.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
How about it? Why don't we invite <chrname> and our 
other girls out for a meal after this?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...They're not the types to mingle just 
for the sake of it, but maybe an 
all-you-can-eat buffet would entice them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Of course, participation is completely 
optional, so if they don't show up, we'll 
just—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Taking our time to enjoy the cuisine 
with just us adults wouldn't be so bad, 
would it?

When I called out to my trainees, everyone 
gathered right away. We spent a lively, 
enjoyable time together.
